messages:
Asha: quick ping — PR #5412 is ready for merge when we have one more approval. Mostly small renames + fmt. Trying to hit tomorrow's merge window.
Sam: skimmed — looks fine to me. tiny naming nit in kvcache.go (non-blocking).
Mira: @Asha can you split the proto tag change out? eng-infra prefers separate PRs for proto churn.
Asha: I can split but CI is green now; splitting will add a commit and maybe another CI run.
Jordan: saw a linter warning in formatter_test.go, small regex var name thing, not a blocker. snippet: ```diff
- if re.MatchString(s) {
+ if reCompiled.MatchString(s) {
 }
```
Luis: I'll take a look in ~30m. If it's purely style, we can fast-track.
ci-bot: build/test: success — all checks passed (unit, integration, fmt).
Mira: infra note: please don't waive proto tag review without eng-infra +1. @eng-infra
Sam: also run `gofmt -w .` — couple files still show formatting diffs locally.
Asha: done, pushed force-with-lease. Also added a one-line CHANGES.md entry under docs/. PTAL.
Jordan: LGTM aside from the proto split. If you open the split PR, ping me and I will approve this one.
Luis: approved. :thumbsup:
Mira: acknowledged — will wait for infra +1 on the proto-only PR.
eng-infra: quick check — proto tag mutation affects wire compatibility; recommend separate PR and a short compatibility note.
Asha: OK splitting now, opening follow-up PR for proto tags only. will link here when ready.
Asha: follow-up PR created: #5420 — proto tags only. https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/5420
Jordan: thanks, approving #5412 now. merge when CI is green.
Asha: merged #5412 into main. :tada: Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround!
Mira: nice, thanks all.
Luis: nice work — good to keep proto churn isolated.
